title: Announcement
description: A prepared announcement the voice stack can speak through the room speaker. The set is managed by the API, the app only lists and plays them in this sprint.

title.description: Short title shown in the app, 1 to 80 characters.

text.description: Text that is spoken, 1 to 600 characters.

category.description: Category, used for grouping and icon.

language.description: Spoken language as a BCP 47 tag, for example en-US or uz-UZ.

duration_s.description: Expected playback length, seconds, integer 1 to 120.

last_played_at.description: Last playback start, ISO 8601 UTC, null when never played.

examples.title: Ten minute break
examples.text: We will take a ten minute break. The lecture continues at the next bell.
